dialog.roleDatabaseHint: Generates barcodes, reprints labels and keeps the sample database.
dialog.roleOperatorHint: Updates sample stages with the mobile app. Sees only the dashboard on the web.

face.cameraBlank: The camera is on but sending no picture. The lens may be covered, or another application may be using it.
face.cameraDenied: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera in your browser and try again.
face.cameraInsecure: The camera only works over HTTPS or on localhost. This page was opened over a plain connection, so the browser will not offer the camera prompt at all.
face.cameraMissing: No usable camera on this device.
face.consentBody: Face data is specific personal data under UU PDP No. 27/2022. The person being enrolled must agree knowingly and may withdraw at any time.
face.consentCheck: This person has been told and agrees to their face being enrolled
face.consentRequired: Consent must be ticked before enrolling.
face.enrollDifferentPerson: This reading looks like somebody else. Make sure only one person is in front of the camera.
face.enrollSubtitle: Take {count} readings for {name}. Ask them to face the camera, turn slightly, and blink.
face.enrollTooSimilar: Too close to the previous reading. Change the angle of your head a little.
face.noFace: No face detected. Check the lighting and try again.
face.notAlive: No blink seen. Look at the camera and blink once.
face.poseDown: Tilt your head down a little
face.qualityOffCentre: Centre your face inside the outline.
face.qualityTooClose: Too close. Move back a little.
face.qualityTooDark: Too dark. Add light or turn towards it.
face.qualityTooFar: Too far away. Move closer to the camera.
face.qualityUnsure: The face is not clear yet. Look straight at the camera.
face.removeConfirm: Remove {name}'s face data? They will sign in with a password alone, and their readings are deleted for good.
face.subtitle: Look at the camera and blink once.
face.title: Face check
face.serviceDown: Face recognition is temporarily unavailable. Please ask an administrator.
face.serviceBusy: Face recognition is busy right now. It will try again in a moment.
face.previewExpired: Your sign-in attempt has expired. Go back and enter your password again.
face.positioning: Position your face inside the oval
face.autoVerify: The camera checks on its own once you are in the oval

mfa.chooseSubtitle: Choose how to verify to finish signing in.
mfa.methodFaceHint: Face the camera and blink once
mfa.methodSetupHint: Connect Microsoft Authenticator on your phone
mfa.totpSubtitle: Open Microsoft Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code for your ATARA account.
mfa.mismatch: That code is wrong or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
mfa.setupScanHint: In Microsoft Authenticator, tap ＋ → Other account → Scan a QR code. Don't have it? Install it from the Play Store or App Store.
mfa.setupCodeHint: Type the 6-digit code Microsoft Authenticator shows for your ATARA account.

admin.title: Microsoft Authenticator
admin.statusOff: Not enabled. {name} signs in without an Authenticator code.
admin.statusPending: Waiting for setup since {date}. {name} will be asked to scan a QR code at their next sign-in.
admin.requireHint: At their next sign-in, after the password, {name} scans a QR code with their own phone. You will not see the code.
admin.resetHint: Use this when a phone is lost or replaced. Codes from the old phone stop working at once, and {name} sets it up again at their next sign-in.
admin.disableHint: {name} will no longer be asked for an Authenticator code when signing in.
admin.pendingHint: Waiting to be set up at the next sign-in

password.roleDefault: That is the role's default password. Choose one of your own.

help.title: Guide

account.title: Your account
account.intro: Settings in the menu under your name, top right.

steps.1: Change your password there; other devices signed in to your account are signed out.
steps.2: Switch language and light or dark appearance.
steps.3: One account is signed in on one browser and one phone at a time: signing in elsewhere signs the old one out.

account.tip: Signing in on another browser signs the old one out. If you are signed out unexpectedly, someone may be using your account.

tour.savesData: Saves data — only try it if you mean to.
tour.notShown: This part is not on screen yet (there may be no data, or your role does not have it). Carry on to the next step.
tour.finished: Tour finished. Open the Guide to try another one.
tour.noSample: There is no sample to try this on yet.
